question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**once in a while**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**once in a while**" means occasionally or at irregular intervals. (कभी-कभी)
 
• "**once in a while**" fits best in this context, as it refers to seeing girls around sometimes, but not constantly. The passage suggests an infrequent but occasional presence of girls at the games.
 
• Other options ("**rarely**", "**all the time**", "**mostly**") do not fit the context of something happening occasionally.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**once in a while**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"mostly" **(मुख्य रूप से): Refers to the majority of times or cases. **Example: **Mostly, I prefer staying at home during weekends.
 
• **"rarely" **(कम ही): Means something that happens very infrequently. **Example: **I rarely visit the beach in winter.
 
• **"all the time" **(हमेशा): Refers to something that happens continuously or constantly. **Example: **He plays games all the time and never takes breaks.
